# Spectrea Brand Guide

> The complete brand system for Spectrea — a composable knowledge platform that turns scattered information into compounding intelligence. This index lists the canonical documents an LLM should read to understand Spectrea's voice, visual identity, logo rules, colour system, typography, and component specs.

**Strategic claim (v2, 2026-04-18):** Spectrea is the spectrum of clarity. Everything you know, in one living view — alive with possibility, yours to keep. See it whole. Trust what you see. Build on what you find.

The brand stakes a position around clarity, aliveness, and ownership — readable on its own without any product context. Differentiates from Notion (substrate-only), Stripe (one-accent infrastructure), Anthropic (editorial-research), Linear (austere modern), and Replit / Vercel (developer tooling).

Spectrea splits its archetype across three surface domains: **Magician** on marketing surfaces (discovery, surprise), **Sage** on trust surfaces (anywhere users go to confirm, review, or understand), **Creator** on product surfaces (anywhere users compose or shape something of their own). The visual aesthetic stays consistent across all three; only voice and emotional register shift per surface.

The brand combines spectrum accents (Cobalt, Teal, Amber, Rose) with a Warm Blend neutral palette (Canvas, Cloud, Pewter, Graphite, Ink) to feel both precise and human. Tagline: *We connect the dots.* Pronunciation: /spek-TREE-uh/. Etymology — dual reading: (1) *spectrum* — the full range, the complete view; (2) *revealing* — bringing what was hidden into clear view. Together: the spectrum of clarity.

**Illustration system (v3) — four layers + four channels.** Vocabulary: Layer 1 atoms (Dot, Curve, Cluster, Trail, Field) + Layer 2 forms (rounded rect, square, triangle, arc, half-circle, soft blob) + Layer 3 treatments (filled, outlined, halo, layered) + Layer 4 palette & 60/20/10/10 ratio. Plus seven craft moves (Arc, Halo, Painterly Field, Spectrum Band, Translucent Plate, Keyline Rule, Hand-imperfect Mark) and a paper grain. Two paired styles: Editorial Geometry (Stripe Press lineage) for brand surfaces; Living Graph (Vercel/Linear lineage) for product surfaces. Production split across four channels: in-house SVG (~80%), AI image-gen via locked prompt (~15%), designer commissioned (~5%), and Canva for template-driven recurring formats (optional).

**Signature motion (three primitives):** node arrival (~400ms elastic settle + radial pulse), edge formation (~300ms gradient draw), spectrum shift (~600ms Cobalt→Teal→Amber→Rose traversal as the AI-acted signal).

## Canonical documents

- [Full brand guide (Markdown)](/brand-guide.md): The single source of truth. Covers foundation, voice, logo system (two-forms rule, 11 variants, 3 arrangements), Warm Blend colour system, gradient rules (OKLCH with sRGB fallback, 3-stop primary, 5-stop lockup, three duets), typography (Albert Sans / Lexend / JetBrains Mono), iconography (Tabler, 2px stroke), motion, components, communications, and governance. Includes inline SVG visuals for logo, swatches, gradients, and typography.
- [Full brand guide (PDF)](/brand-guide.pdf): Printable version of the same content.

## Key facts

- **Name:** Spectrea (not "Spectre", "Spectra", or "SpectreAI").
- **Pronunciation:** /spek-TREE-uh/.
- **Tagline:** "We connect the dots."
- **Category:** Composable knowledge platform.
- **Spectrum colours:** Cobalt `#4271DF` · Teal `#00B6A0` · Amber `#E19000` · Rose `#F24260`.
- **Warm Blend neutrals:** Canvas `#FDFDFB` · Cloud `#F4F4F1` · Pewter `#97979E` · Graphite `#212226` · Ink `#18181C`.
- **Brand gradient:** `linear-gradient(135deg in oklch, #4271DF, #00B6A0, #E19000)` with sRGB fallback for older browsers.
- **Lockup gradient (LogotypeGradient only):** 5-stop full spectrum with `#6FB884` intermediate at 55%.
- **Typefaces:** Albert Sans (headings, 600/700), Lexend (body, 300/400/500), JetBrains Mono (code, 400).
- **Archetypes (v2 tri-domain split):** Magician on marketing · Sage on trust surfaces · Creator on product surfaces.
- **Personality (v2, 4 traits):** Warm · Perceptive · Grounded · Adaptive (each with a guardrail). The brand's discipline and consistency are enforced structurally by the system rules (fixed primitives, fixed palette, fixed motion language) rather than claimed as a personality trait.
- **Voice formula (v2):** "Clarity of explanation + experiential momentum. Tech earns its place by **showing its work**." (Replaces the v1 "explaining the magic" formulation.)
- **Privileged vocabulary (v2, 12 brand-evocative words):** spectrum, clarity, whole, see, reveal, illuminate, surface, connect, compose, compound, alive, transparent. Each builds the brand feeling without product context. Product-specific words (provenance, traceable, auditable, attributed, sourced) are still allowed when describing what the product actually does.
- **Illustration system (v3, 2026-04-18 late):** four layers (Atoms · Forms · Treatments · Palette) + seven craft moves + two paired styles (Editorial Geometry + Living Graph) + four production channels (in-house SVG · AI image-gen · designer · Canva). Decision rubric routes each surface to the channel that can actually deliver it. v2 Dot System (five atoms only) is retained as a proper subset for system artefacts and small-scale compositions. See `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-18-illustration-system-v3-design.md`.
- **Feature naming convention (v2):** Title-case Proper Nouns without brand prefix. The capital signals "this is a named thing in Spectrea." Generic nouns stay lowercase in prose ("the assistant suggested"). Brand prefix reserved for distinct branded surfaces only — separately-paid tiers, developer surfaces, installable companions.
- **Signature motion primitives (v2):** Arrival (~400ms), Formation (~300ms), Spectrum sweep (~600ms — the brand's signature moment, used sparingly).
